title: Frog Button Puff Sleeve Peplum V-Neck Blouse
body_html:
Product Details

Core Design Features

  1. Neckline & Sleeve Craft Deep plunging V-neck to lengthen the neckline; short bubble puff sleeves with shoulder gathering detailing to soften broad shoulders, lightweight short sleeve silhouette ideal for spring and summer wear.
  2. Oriental Frog Button Placket 3 handmade black Chinese knot frog buttons line the center front placket, the signature traditional oriental decorative detail creating striking dark contrast against raw dark denim fabric, blending classic Chinese aesthetics with casual denim styling.
  3. Waist & Hem Silhouette Defined fitted high waist with flared peplum ruffle hem; the tailored cinched waist flows outward into a frilly swing hem, shaping an hourglass figure, concealing midsection imperfections for a feminine flattering fit.
  4. Fabric Characteristic Washed soft dark denim woven fabric with moderate structural stiffness; sturdy enough to hold puff sleeve and peplum hem shape while remaining skin-friendly, breathable and wrinkle-resistant for daily wear.

Style Positioning

Modern Chinese casual commuter top / Oriental aesthetic daily wear / Date feminine blouse / Tea party New Chinese style top 

Fabric & Thickness Medium-weight soft washed denim, slight stretch, air-wicking texture suitable for warm spring and summer days Applicable Scenarios Office daily commuting, oriental-themed afternoon tea, weekend city sightseeing, casual family gatherings, short-distance travel outfits Fit & Fabric

  • Elasticity: Mild stretch soft denim fabric
  • Fit Type: Slim fitted waist peplum silhouette; gathered puff sleeves balance the structured V-neck front, merging laid-back denim texture with elegant traditional Chinese detailing

Size Chart

Note

  1. Mild stretch soft denim offers forgiving fit for various body shapes, a 2~3cm manual measurement deviation is normal.
  2. Deep V neck puff sleeves + handcrafted Chinese frog button placket + flared peplum hem are core design highlights; dark washed denim paired with classic oriental knot buttons delivers subtle elegant New Chinese casual vibe.
  3. Matching Reference:
    • Soft Oriental Look: White wide-leg chiffon trousers + Mary Jane flat shoes + thin jade bangle
    • Casual Y2K Look: High-waisted denim mini skirt + platform canvas sneakers
    • Smart Office Look: Black tailored straight-leg suit pants + pointed low-heel pumps
  4. Care Tip: Wash separately with cold water for the first time to prevent color bleeding; hand wash gently to protect delicate frog button stitching from fraying.
